_comment: The precache CPU cells the branch-coverage job runs (tools/ci/run_precache_suites.py), 2026-10-23 at claude/sfd-1p15: the cells that pass alone, by exact id, on Linux with only tools/gen_paged_kv_fixture.py's four generated fixtures, and take under 15 s each under clang-18 coverage instrumentation (about 75 s for the whole list on a loaded 4-core machine). Left out: cells that read box artifacts (real models, E0 artifacts, references, GPU captures, cross-compiler blobs) or the synthetic 0.5B/1.5B models, which no cloud generator makes (several of those pass in a batch only because an earlier cell's failed synthetic load is cached, so each listed cell was run alone); the 4.x grids and the 32k cells; and the slow cells 2.6/E3, 5.10/E3 and 1.2/E3. A cell is added only once it passes alone in the cloud and is fast. 2026-10-24 (delta prefix saves): the E6 cells, all cloud-only on the generated fixtures.
